## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Every object writer drops the served `options` of a picklist-bound field before saving, through the one helper

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-06T06:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Re-read on objectui `main` (`c3623eb116`): live, and not a duplicate of objectui#11674–#11690.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` (about `:259`–`:264`), `packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.tsx` (about `:954`), `MetadataObjectsPage.tsx` (about `:257`) and `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts` (`saveMetadataItem` about `:708`, `saveObject` about `:808`, `saveFields` about `:898`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: only `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (about `:3728` and `:3796`) calls `dropServedPicklistOptions`. The other writers re-send the served read, and the server refuses `options` beside `picklist` with a 422 on the whole save.

- **Correction to the card:** `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` never saves an object (`RuntimeArtifactType` is `view`, `report`, `dashboard` or `page`), so it is out of scope.
- **Why p2:** any app using the 17.6 shared picklists cannot save an object from these surfaces (sharing defaults, the fields page, the objects page): the whole save is refused. A stock demo binds no picklist, so it does not show there.
- **Direction:**
  - One helper, applied once at the save door every object writer goes through (`MetadataService`) or at each listed writer, not re-implemented per page.
  - ⛔ The server's refusal of inline `options` beside `picklist` stays: it is the authoring check objectui#10202 relies on.
- **Pin:** each listed writer saves a picklist-bound object it read and did not touch, and the server receives no `options` on the bound field.

## Claim amendment: the file surface widens to `EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx`. A patch round on PR objectui#11706 follows before review

`domain:ui` execution seat 2 · `session_01FngvPpdrnhHMdHHq6vwwju` (`os-justin`) · 2026-10-06T08:35Z. This amends claim `6011332561`; the branch, the assignee and `Clause-②: yes` are unchanged.

**Why.** The dev report on this card names one more writer of the same defect.
- `EmbeddedItemEditor`'s `doSave` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx`), mounted by `MetadataDetailDrawer` from an object's fields / indexes / validations anchors, re-reads `client.layered(parentType, parentName).effective`, which is a served read.
- It splices the edited item in, and PUTs the whole parent object without `dropServedPicklistOptions`.
- The dev's scratch probe, never committed, mounted the editor over a served bound `tier` field and saved an edit of `amount`. It answered `expected [ fields.tier.options ] to deeply equal []`.

Triage's direction for this card is "Every object writer drops the served `options` of a picklist-bound field before saving", so this writer is inside the card. It meets the four bounded in-place conditions:
- it is the same defect class;
- the fix is one wrap of the body, the shape the four writers in the PR already take;
- no other open PR or claim touches the file (open PRs objectui#11703 and objectui#11069, and this seat's in-flight branches, were read);
- it falls under the same `app-shell` gate family.

**Amended file surface:** the claim's surface, plus `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx` (its `doSave`) and a pin beside it.

**Next:** a patch round on PR objectui#11706 by the same dev, adding this writer and its pin. The seat's review and the at-tier contract review (`Clause-②: yes`, the new `@object-ui/data-objectstack` export) run on the patched head.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11706 at `32b8c2e` (`Fixes #11692`), after patch round 1. The at-tier contract review is owed before enqueue

`domain:ui` execution seat 2 · `session_01FngvPpdrnhHMdHHq6vwwju` (`os-justin`) · 2026-10-06T08:59Z. Dev reports: round 0 and patch round 1 (`6012839770`) on this card.

- **Shape:** draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #11692`, and the body has no other closing keyword. `Clause-②: yes` is at the start of a line. 17 files, all inside the claim's surface as amended by `6012529702`. No governed path. +942/−21.
  - The branch merged `main` at `3409fe8` as a merge commit, with no rebase and no force push, and nothing conflicted.
  - The PR body was replaced by the seat from the dev's `pr_body_patch` in this stroke. The relay read back 14468 bytes, identical.
- **Seat's own reading of the diff:**
  - `dropServedPicklistOptions` moves, by `git mv` with its test, to `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, and is exported from its barrel. That is the one widening, which makes this `Clause-②: yes`.
  - `app-shell`'s two callers are re-pointed, and no copy is left.
  - It is applied before the PUT at five writers: the OWD overview, the Setup fields page, the Setup objects page, `EmbeddedItemEditor`'s `doSave` (for an `object` parent only), and `MetadataService.saveFields`.
  - `saveObject` and `saveMetadataItem` read nothing, so they stay unchanged. `MetadataClient.save` is unchanged, which keeps triage's ⛔: the server still refuses an authored `picklist` + `options` pair.
- **Changeset prose (`data-objectstack` `minor`, `app-shell` and `plugin-designer` `patch`), checked sentence by sentence against the diff:** the headline names the five writers, the five bullets match the five call sites, the "keeps its inline `options` unchanged" sentence matches the helper's pins, and the export paragraph (moved, not exported before, not applied at the door) matches the barrel and `MetadataClient`.
- **Tests:** six 422-refusing-transport pin files, each over a real `MetadataClient` (or the real adapter and SDK for `MetadataService`). Five ablation legs, each red with the door's `refused at fields.tier.options` and restored by blob. The patch round's 9 files and 39 tests passed at `32b8c2e`. The round-1 narrowed set, 247 files, passed at `bc90d2f`; the full `app-shell` suite is declared to CI.
- **Accepted trade-off, stated in the PR's Acceptance notes:** the drawer's generic field form can no longer save an `options` edit on a field that keeps its `picklist`, the same rule the other writers and the Studio data page apply. Unbinding stays the job of objectui#10202's "Options from" picker.
- **Out-of-scope:** `MetadataService`'s three save methods have no in-repo caller. This is in the Acceptance notes, not filed.
- **Owed before enqueue:** the at-tier contract review (`Clause-②: yes`, the new `@object-ui/data-objectstack` export). `needs:contract-review` is hung on the PR in this stroke.

This is unmeasured. What would file it: open an object field that names a picklist in the metadata-admin drawer, and read whether an `options` control renders.
